name: Run Trace drawer reveals the seeded Project context block for the Security Reviewer run
description: PR #482 → Agent runs tab → Timeline's seeded Security Reviewer run (newest-first) → open its trace drawer → click its 'Specs read' chip, which opens the collapsed Prompt assembly section and the 'Project context — attached specs (untrusted)' block (AC-56), and confirm the attached specs/security-baseline.md text is visible (AC-53). The trace was seeded through the same renderProjectContext() the run executor uses (U7), so this is a byte-real block, not a hand-typed stand-in. Read-only, no model call.
